statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to evaluate for potential arrhythmias contributing to hemodynamic instability
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate clinical events with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
CPT code 93247 is medically necessary to evaluate for arrhythmias contributing to these symptoms
